newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Moos hopes to return to profit in 1998.
newsitem.headline: Von Moos hopes to return to profit in 1998.

text.p: Swiss steel concern Von Moos said that it hoped to return to profit in 1998.
The company also said at a news briefing that it expected an operating loss for 1996 of at least 50 million Swiss francs. It declined to give a forecast for 1997.
The company has also named Robert Jeker as new chairman, to replace current chairman Klaus Hug.
The appointment of Jeker is pending approval of shareholders at an extraordinary meeting called for December 12.
Trade in shares of Von Moos was suspended on the Swiss stock exchange earlier on Wednesday amid speculation of changes in the leadership at the Swiss concern.
